node.control.log.name: Write log
node.control.log.description: Log connected Message text directly, or numbers, booleans, null, objects and arrays as JSON. Use the saved message when unconnected. Pass value through and preserve causation and privacy metadata. NOLOG skips recording and continues with the original value.
node.control.pass.name: Pass value

node.control.publish.name: Publish event

node.math.add.name: Add
node.math.add.description: Calculate left + right using finite IEEE 754 binary64 numbers. Decimal rounding applies. Strings require explicit conversion; out-of-range results and division by zero fail.
node.math.subtract.name: Subtract
node.math.subtract.description: Calculate left − right using finite IEEE 754 binary64 numbers. Decimal rounding applies. Strings require explicit conversion; out-of-range results and division by zero fail.
node.math.multiply.name: Multiply
node.math.multiply.description: Calculate left × right using finite IEEE 754 binary64 numbers. Decimal rounding applies. Strings require explicit conversion; out-of-range results and division by zero fail.
node.math.divide.name: Divide
node.math.divide.description: Calculate left ÷ right using finite IEEE 754 binary64 numbers. Decimal rounding applies. Strings require explicit conversion; out-of-range results and division by zero fail.
node.data.convert.name: Convert scalar
node.data.convert.description: Explicitly convert JSON scalars. Number accepts numeric values or invariant numeric strings as finite binary64, with rounding. Integer uses exact Int64 without truncation. Boolean accepts true/false or exact 0/1, including strings. For numeric-to-string conversion, the format input accepts D4 (zero padding), N0 (digit grouping), F2 (two decimal places), or custom numeric formats. Empty formats and string inputs retain their existing representation. Null, objects, arrays and bytes fail.
node.control.preview.name: Preview
node.control.preview.description: Display the latest input or a bounded history of text and media summaries without downstream outputs.
node.data.concat.name: Concat
node.data.concat.description: Concatenate strings or matching arrays in input-number order. Optional separator text is inserted only between string inputs (omitted or null means empty). Unused ports are ignored; filled ports reveal the next input (up to 64).
node.data.object.expand.name: Expand object
node.data.object.expand.description: Expose each object property as an output. Chain Expand object nodes for nested objects. Use JSON Schema or manual fields when the input structure is unknown.

node.control.signal.first.name: StartSignal merge (First)
node.control.signal.all.name: StartSignal merge (All)
node.control.signal.each.description: Start a new downstream execution for every incoming signal without waiting for other inputs. Empty extra ports are not part of the wait set.
node.control.signal.first.description: By default, take the first start signal within the current request while preserving its data and iteration element. Choose Across requests to retain arrivals until every connected input has participated in a round.
node.control.signal.all.description: Emit once when every connected input has arrived, then reset all inputs. Duplicate arrivals at one input coalesce. State is shared across separate executions.

node.control.ifNotStart.name: IfNot-Start
node.control.ifStart.description: Emit a start signal only when condition is true. Connect it to the next Start input and supply data separately. False skips the branch; non-boolean conditions fail.
node.control.ifNotStart.description: Emit a start signal only when condition is false. Connect it to the next Start input and supply data separately. True skips the branch; non-boolean conditions fail.
node.process.restart.name: Restart application
node.process.restart.description: Stop the registered application, then start it once after confirming its exit.
node.process.lifecycle.name: Application lifecycle
node.process.lifecycle.description: Emit distinct start, stop and restart signals with the observed PID. Events missed while Core was stopped are not replayed.
